data.name: Moses
data.gender_notes: Moses is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Moses is recorded in name-lists as “Drawn out (of the water)”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Moses expresses “Drawn out (of the water)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moses total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Moshe, explained in Exodus 2:10 as 'drawn out' of the water. Its root is Hebrew m-sh-h. Moses, the lawgiver (Exodus 3). Moses is a Hebrew name meaning “Drawn out (of the water)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
